description_expanded: AboutGrayton House – A Luxurious 30A Vacation Home Grayton Beach | 3 Bedrooms Plus Loft | Sleeps 9 | Bikes Included | Large Community Pool | Close to Tram with Stops to the Beach and Nearby Communities, Including Seaside Why Guests Love Grayton House: • Prime Location Along 30A – Nestled in a charming community close to Grayton Beach, Seaside, and top local attractions • Golf Cart perks – Add a golf cart and receive a 10% discount off the golf cart rental rate • Bikes Included – Cruise to the beach, local restaurants, and scenic trails with ease • Large Resort-Style Community Pool – Relax and unwind in a spacious, beautifully designed pool area • Close to Tram with Stops to the Beach and Nearby Communities, Including Seaside – Enjoy quick and convenient access to the sand and surrounding hotspots • Spacious Open-Concept Living – Perfect for entertaining and quality time with family and friends • Gourmet Kitchen – Fully stocked with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large island • Professionally Designed Interiors – A blend of modern elegance and laid-back coastal charm • Covered Outdoor Porch – A cozy and shaded retreat, perfect for soaking in the coastal breeze • Beach Essentials Provided – Backpack beach chairs, umbrella and beach wagon for stress-free beach days • Smart TVs and Free Wi-Fi – Stay connected and entertained throughout your stay • Close to Local Favorites – Minutes from Red Bar, Borago’s, AJ’s, Chiringo’s, Hurricane Oyster Bar, Black Bear Bread Co., and more • Starter amenities in bathrooms and kitchen including Starbucks coffee and bottles of water Your Perfect 30A Luxury Rental Starts Here Located just minutes from Grayton Beach, Grayton House offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Whether you're spending your days relaxing by the stunning resort-style pool, cruising to the beach, or exploring the vibrant dining and shopping scenes of Seaside, this 30A vacation home is designed for unforgettable coastal getaways. Spacious and Stylish Sleeping Arrangements: • 1st Floor Primary Suite – King bed, ensuite bathroom with shower and soaking tub • 2nd Floor Queen Bedroom – Bright and inviting, shared ensuite bathroom with shower/tub combo • 2nd Floor Queen Bedroom – Cozy and stylish, shared ensuite bathroom with shower/tub combo • 2nd Floor Bunk Space – Twin/Queen bunk beds, perfect for kids or extra guests Unbeatable Location and Resort-Style Amenities Grayton House is ideally situated along 30A, giving guests quick access to the area’s top beaches, scenic bike trails, and beloved restaurants. Whether you’re unwinding in the open-concept living space, preparing a gourmet meal in the high-end kitchen, or relaxing in the covered outdoor lounge, this 30A luxury rental offers a relaxing retreat with all the modern comforts.
